# geoDB Open Exploration Protocol

> An open, machine-readable contract for pulling QA/QC'd mineral-exploration
> data out of a geoDB project — drill collars, downhole logging, samples,
> assays with laboratory chain of custody, geophysics, rasters and documents —
> over an authenticated, project-scoped REST + STAC surface. Read-only in
> v0.1.0. A project owner issues a revocable, project-pinned token; every call
> is logged for them to see.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the entry point. Token, the six domain traps that
  produce wrong answers silently, the core profile, the sync loop as runnable
  code, every error code with its remedy, retry policy. Read this first.

## Normative

- [spec/openapi.yaml](spec/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3, NORMATIVE for the wire,
  generated from the reference implementation. Where any other file disagrees,
  this one is right.
- [PROFILE.md](PROFILE.md): which of the served operations are the protocol
  (47) and which are geoDB extensions. Generated from the spec's own flags.
- [errors.json](errors.json): every reason_code, with HTTP status, meaning,
  remedy and whether retrying can help. Generated from the server.
- [schemas/](schemas/): one JSON Schema per core record type — the exploration
  vocabulary, readable one file at a time. Generated from the spec.
- [stac/xpl/schema.json](stac/xpl/schema.json): the `xpl:` STAC extension for
  exploration assets (the first one for geophysics, drilling and mining).

## Runnable

- [examples/](examples/): four flavours — curl, the geodb-client library, bare
  requests, TypeScript fetch. Each under 60 lines, each runs against the public
  sandbox with no signup.
- [conformance/](conformance/): the runner a second implementation points at
  its own server.
- [scripts/regenerate.py](scripts/regenerate.py): re-emit every generated
  artifact from a geoDB checkout. `--check` fails when one has drifted.
- [scripts/validate.py](scripts/validate.py): validate the repo offline, with
  no checkout and no credentials.

## Context

- [README.md](README.md): what this is and why, the two lanes, the auth model.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to file a useful issue; how decisions
  get made. No permission, NDA or partnership is needed to implement or fork.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability; scope; disclosure.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): version history.

## Notes for a model reading this

- `latitude` / `longitude` are the ORIGINAL imported coordinate in the CRS named
  by `epsg` — easting/northing for a projected CRS, degrees only when
  `epsg == 4326`. Read `source_coordinate` or `geometry_geojson` instead.
- Assay values are decimal STRINGS; parse with a decimal type, never a float.
- `cf_*` keys are per-project custom fields; discover them at
  `/api/v2/model-schemas/`.
- Lists page with `limit` / `offset`; `page_size` is ignored.
- Python client: `pip install geodb-client`.
